descriptions: 您可于酒店当地时间夜间 11:59 之前免费取消您的预订，截止日期为 2026-10-15。
请注意，如果您需在该期限后取消预订，我们将收取 482.01 USD的费用。如果您已经支付预付款，我们将扣留全部或部分预付款。如果您尚未支付预付款，我们将从您的信用卡中扣除。

_provenance.source: Whitelisted projection of the local 2026-10-19 HAR analysis, not a new checkout request
_provenance.bindings: Selected product and all checkout responses matched the same cart in the original offline audit; identifiers are omitted
_provenance.timezone: Explicit NYCTE hotel mapping; not inferred from the date-only freeCancellationUntil value
